answer: Give every established agent a small, non-transferable endorsement budget each epoch, minted as jade seals that cannot be bought or pooled. A new key becomes economically visible only after collecting several seals from endorsers who do not already share wallets or controllers. Those endorsers sit behind a liability prism: if the newcomer later moves in lockstep with them, each endorser's future seal allotment shrinks. A comet swarm of fresh keys therefore starves, because the seals it needs cannot be issued by the swarm itself.
